visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a small, ancestral pliosaur with a slightly longer neck than its later cousins.
visual_logic.environment: Deep indigo water with sharp, white surface highlights.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE to highlight the slender, more 'plesiosaur-like' proportions of the neck.
